question: Which of the statements is NOT correct regarding energy?

options.text: The energy possessed by a body due to its change in position or shape is called the potential energy.
An object of mass m moving with velocity v has a kinetic energy of (mv) /2.
The gravitational potential energy of an object of mass, M raised through a height, Hfrom the earth’s surface is given by MgH.
An object in motion possesses what is known as the kinetic energy of the object.

solution:
**The correct answer is Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The kinetic energy of an object is given by the formula KE = 1/2 mv², where m is the mass of the object and v is the velocity of the object.
 
• In this formula, the velocity is squared, so kinetic energy increases with the square of the velocity.
 
• Therefore, an object moving twice as fast has four times the kinetic energy.

Hence statement 2 is incorrect.

 
• Potential energy is the stored energy an object has because of its position or state.
 
• A common example is gravitational potential energy.
 
• An object high off the ground has gravitational potential energy because it can do work as it falls to the ground.
 
• Another example is elastic potential energy stored in a stretched or compressed spring.

**Hence statement 1 is correct.**

 
• The formula for gravitational potential energy near the surface of the Earth is PE = MgH, where m is the mass of the object, g is the acceleration due to gravity (approximately 9.8 m/s² near the Earth's surface), and h is the height above the ground.
 
• So, the potential energy increases linearly with height.

Hence statement 3 is correct.

 
• An object in motion has kinetic energy because it has the capacity to do work by virtue of its motion.
 
• The amount of kinetic energy an object has depends on both its mass and how fast it's moving.
 
• As I mentioned in statement 2, the formula for kinetic energy is 1/2 mv².

**Hence statement 4 is correct.**
